scores.notes: Daniel climbs out over the den rim as two men haul the ropes, the glad king in purple gestures with open arms, lions lie quiet below; no lettering, full bleed, hands sound.
Night storm; Jesus asleep on a rolled cushion in the stern while two disciples shake him and others cling to the mast and bail; no lettering, full bleed, no faults seen.

Holmes studies the corner pawnshop beside the railed weedy enclosure with Watson behind; signboards are blank so no lettering. Bare white paper at all four corners and the left/right edges (accepted). Details off but not faults: four gilt balls, pipe and lens instead of a stick; Holmes is a gaunt generic type, not clearly one actor.

Saul seated with arm flung out, a spear in mid-air toward David who dodges at the wall, a second spear already stuck in the stone (twice), harp on the floor; no spirit figure, no lettering, full bleed.
Jesus stands in the boat with raised hand, storm cloud at left giving way to calm bright sky at right, disciples watch from mast and oars; no lettering, full bleed, no faults seen.
Moses stretches his hand over the sea, wind-bent trees, waves rearing apart from an opening sandy path, Israelites behind him; no figure for God, no lettering, full bleed.
Bald Elisha in a fur mantle walks up the road toward the walled city while a ring of youths point and jeer; dignified, no lettering, full bleed, hands sound.
Night courtyard with fire; Jesus, led by guards at left, looks across at Peter in the right foreground who turns back with hand on chest; no lettering, full bleed, no faults seen.

Lettering is only the heart/spade/diamond pips on the small card soldiers in the background croquet game (unreadable). Bare paper at the right edge and top-right corner (accepted). Alice sits with her flamingo laid down talking to the grinning Cat; the Cat is shown whole-bodied on a branch rather than as a head in the air (noted, not counted).
Daniel stands unharmed among five resting lions in the stone den, looking up to the king kneeling at the rim with a torch; the angel is only a shaft of golden light; no lettering, full bleed.

Tiny letter-like engraved glyphs (resembling 'Go') on the band of the hookah base, centre; too small to count as readable. Otherwise the moment is right: Caterpillar on the mushroom with hookah mouthpiece out of its mouth facing a mushroom-height Alice; full bleed, no white edge. Caterpillar wears bowler and waistcoat with an old-man face on a caterpillar body (not counted).

Alice in the long lamp-lit hall of doors holds the little bottle up to inspect its label, key on the small table beside her; the label is blank (checked enlarged), no lettering, full bleed, hands sound.

Small price-tag cards in the bands of the Hatter's and March Hare's hats carry unreadable scribble marks (top centre); that is the only fault. Tea party is right: sleepy Dormouse, Hare pouring, Hatter pointing, Alice with bread-and-butter; full bleed, hands sound.

Man with a knife stands over the concubine's intact, clothed body on a bench in his house, empty baskets and cloths ready; handled without blood or gore. Three horrified anonymous onlookers are added (not counted as a named/narrator figure). No lettering, full bleed.

Brick vault cellar: Holmes kneels with lantern and magnifying lens over the flagstones, Merryweather in top hat perches injured on a crate with his stick on the floor, Watson stands behind, crates of coin around; no lettering, full bleed. Holmes is a gaunt slick-haired type, not clearly one specific actor.

Moses sits on a stone on the hilltop while Hur and Aaron (in breastplate) each hold up one of his hands, battle below and sun low; the hand on Moses' shoulder is Hur's other hand, not an extra limb. No lettering, full bleed.
Samuel pours the horn of oil on young David's bowed head with Jesse and the brothers standing round; the Spirit is only sun rays through cloud; no lettering, full bleed, hands sound.

Moses seated on a stone with Aaron (breastplate) steadying the staff his right hand grips at head height and Hur supporting his other arm, battle and sunset behind; no lettering, full bleed. Weakness noted but not counted: the hand Hur holds rests down at Moses' knee rather than raised.

Alice appears several times: besides the foreground Alice with her flamingo, a girl in the same yellow dress runs in the middle distance and blue-pinafore Alice lookalikes play at left and centre (collage of moments). Courtiers beside the Queen (man in ruff, lady in blue gown) are ordinary humans, not flat cards. Lettering: card pips and court-card art on the arch soldiers plus a legible corner index '6' on the standing six of spades at right. Bare paper at top-left/top (accepted).
Ezekiel alone in the valley, arm raised and speaking over a floor of dry bones and skulls; God is not drawn; the tablet he holds is blank (checked enlarged); no lettering, full bleed.

The priest bends at the ash heap beside the court hanging with the bird, tabernacle and altar at right, but at left a second, miniature tabernacle court stands in the camp with four giant robed figures inside it, taller than the tent itself: the tabernacle is shown twice at contradictory scales. No lettering, full bleed, God not drawn.

The picture is a standing teacher with scrolls at his belt (reads as Paul) addressing seated villagers: the letter's own author drawn as speaker of his words, the prominent central figure. Bare paper along the right side and at three corners (accepted). No lettering on the rolled scrolls, hands sound.
Cheshire Cat grinning with many teeth and long claws on a mossy bough, Alice standing below looking up timidly; no lettering, full bleed, hands sound.

A robed elder kneels on a scaffold setting a stone into Jerusalem's wall, helped by a youth with a trowel and labourers carrying baskets of stone, temple beyond; no lettering, full bleed, no faults seen.

Pillar of cloud stands on the tabernacle in its curtained court amid the vast tent camp; people in the foreground roll bedding, coil rope and load a donkey cart, which sits a little oddly with the cloud still resting (noted, not counted). No lettering, full bleed.

Scene is right: station-master points to the fire and huge smoke column behind the clump of trees, inspector, Holmes, Watson and the bandaged engineer on the platform, train steaming off. Only doubt: in the bottom-right corner a short row of pen strokes at the foot of the brick wall looks like a scribbled, illegible signature but may be grass hatching; marked as lettering, hence uncertain. Full bleed, no white edge.

Only fault is tiny unreadable marks on the tag in the Hatter's hat band and the tick-marked watch dial pinned to his coat (right of centre). Bare paper down the right side and corners (accepted). Tea party is right: Alice with bread-and-butter, dozing Dormouse, Hatter pointing, March Hare pouring; hands sound.

Alice holds an ordinary wooden croquet mallet while standing over one live flamingo, with a second flamingo lying on the grass: the mallet contradicts the flamingo-mallet game shown beside it. The Cat floats in the air whole-bodied rather than as a head only (noted). Lettering is just the pips and corner marks on the tiny diamond card soldier in the distance. Sky fades to bare paper at top-left (accepted).

Ezekiel alone with arm raised, speaking over a valley floor strewn with dry bones under a low sun; God is not drawn; the small tablet he holds is blank (checked enlarged). Bare paper shows at the left margin and top-left corner (accepted).

David at left with sling extended, Goliath pitching head-first into the dust, both armies looking on; no blood. Bare white paper along the top and corners (accepted). Noted, not counted: a stone still sits in David's sling and the Philistines wear Roman-style crested helmets. No lettering.

No mirror, dim reflection or face-to-face image anywhere: it is a bearded teacher (reads as Paul) seated at a stone table with a scroll and lamp addressing a dozen listeners in a Greek city, so the verse's image is missing and the author is drawn as speaker of his own words. Open scroll on the table has faint unreadable squiggle lines. Sky fades to bare paper along the top (accepted).

Only fault is newsprint: rows of squiggle lines and bold headline-like blots on the papers in Holmes's lap, on the seats and on the flying paper ball, all unreadable. Bare paper at the left and right edges (accepted). Moment is right: the two alone in the carriage, Holmes tossing the great ball of papers toward the rack. Holmes is a gaunt generic type, not clearly one actor.

Only fault is the heart and spade pips on the two flat card soldiers guarding the Knave (centre-left), unreadable. The Rabbit's paper, the jurors' slates and floor papers are blank. Moment is right: White Rabbit in spectacles reading on a box, King with sceptre, Queen, Alice protesting, animal jury. White at top-left is a window, not bare paper.
Rays of light break through dark cloud over a dark, formless sea; no figure of any kind for God, no lettering, full bleed.

The verse is the six-wing description, but the five seraphim are conventional robed angels with a single pair of wings each (the centre one perhaps two pairs), faces veiled by cloth rather than wings and feet bare, so the creatures do not follow the text; the centre one also carries tongs with a coal from a later verse. Isaiah watches from below; God is only cloud and light. No lettering, full bleed.

Night: the king kneels at the den's rim with his signet ring while two men rope the round stone over the mouth and the lords watch with torches; no lettering. Painted to all four edges, so no unpainted edge even though the style allows it.

The king in purple presses his signet ring into clay on the stone laid over the den while lords press their own gold seals and a servant holds the clay cup, soldiers behind; no lettering, full bleed, hands sound. An iron-bound wooden hatch beside the stone is a small oddity, not counted.

Card soldiers and attendants (left foreground man, figures at the right edge and behind the Knave) are ordinary full-bodied humans in heart-patterned tabards, not flat oblong cards. The White Rabbit's paper is covered in illegible cursive pseudo-script with a signature-like last line, and the tabards carry heart pips. Moment otherwise right: Rabbit in spectacles reading, King, Queen, Knave, tall Alice, animal jury with slates.

David kneels at the brook with smooth stones in his shepherd's pouch and sling in hand, the armies and the lone Philistine in the distance; staff lies beside him rather than in his hand (minor). Picture vignettes into bare white paper on all sides (accepted). No lettering.

Holmes's face and dark curly hair clearly read as Benedict Cumberbatch, the screen Sherlock, breaking the no-screen-adaptation-faces rule. Papers on the desk carry rows of unreadable pseudo-text and the mantel clock has an illegible dial. Moment is right: Lestrade leaning over the desk as Holmes studies the small paper. Painted to the edges; white at top is window and picture mounts.

The dominant figure is a staff-bearing prophet gesturing toward a stooped, exhausted man propped up by a companion below Jerusalem: the speaker of the oracle drawn inside his own words. He reads as a prophet, not as God, so no rule break. No lettering, full bleed, hands sound.
